function: Joint BS beamforming and STAR-IRS reflection/transmission coefficient design (secrecy-rate maximization) by a GNN. p. 5.
system: 8-antenna BS, single-antenna user and 2 single-antenna eavesdroppers; STAR-IRS with 80 elements (simultaneously transmitting and reflecting); indoor; frequency band not stated. pp. 3, 8.
method: GNN with two GCN layers and two FC output layers; unsupervised training on negative secrecy rate with SGD, offline; FPGA inference accelerator. pp. 5-6.
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician fading (factor 0.3), log-distance path loss, random Eve distances 4-8 m; no standard model, dataset or measurement; sample count not stated. p. 7.
test_conditions: Single Rician simulator described; transmit power, number of Eves, STAR-IRS elements and CSI error swept; no train/test split or unseen scenario stated. pp. 8-9.
baselines: Non-learned: MRT, ZF, MMSE beamformers with random STAR-IRS coefficients. Own-GNN variants: conventional STAR-IRS and reflection-only IRS. No earlier learned method compared. p. 8.
metrics: Secrecy rate versus iterations, transmit power, number of Eves, STAR-IRS elements and CSI error; FPGA latency; quantized versus floating-point secrecy rate. pp. 8-10.
complexity: GCN layer O(C^2+CFF') dense, O(M+CFF') sparse (C nodes, F and F' features, M edges); FPGA inference latency 8.992 ms at 10 ns clock. pp. 6, 9.
q1_support: p. 7: "channels are modeled as Rician fading". Custom simulator with log-distance path loss; no 3GPP model, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 8: "These parameters can vary when used as the horizontal axis." Only sweeps are reported; the paper never says a trained model is tested in an unseen scenario or whether it is retrained per value, and gives no train/test split.
q3_support: p. 8: "AN-MRT: This legend denotes the maximum ratio transmission (MRT) scheme". MRT, ZF and MMSE are non-learned, but CONV-GNN and IRS-GNN reuse the proposed GNN and no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "The measured latency is 8.992 ms with a 10 ns clock period."
q5_support: p. 7: "channels are modeled as Rician fading". Channels come from the authors' simulator; no code or data link and no public dataset; the only hardware experiment is FPGA inference (p. 9).
notes: Included, area 3: the GNN outputs the BS beamformer and the STAR-IRS coefficients (p. 5). The objective is secrecy rate (physical-layer security), flagged so the reviewer confirms the function. PDF is arXiv v1 of 13 Oct 2025 (p. 1) and prints no DOI, so the DOI was not checked against it. Order of complexity on p. 6; the FPGA experiment measures latency and quantization loss only, with simulated channels (p. 9).
